egress.terms: unmetered, Cloudflare-fronted (Server: cloudflare, Cache-Control public max-age=14400).

record.interface_detail: NIP-96 HTTP file storage. Discoverable at /.well-known/nostr/nip96.json; POST /upload; /presigned 'handles up to 5 GB'.
record.tooling: curl; NIP-98 Authorization header (signed event). The llms.txt documents the /presigned path for large objects.
record.chaining: Machine-readable plan manifest means the cap is queryable rather than scraped. One GET tells you the size ceiling per plan.
record.limits_note: Per-object-cap 25 MiB free. 125 MB on the direct /upload, 5 GB via /presigned (per llms.txt). The /presigned path is the one that matters and it is far above the free plan's advertised 25 MiB.
record.reliability_note: Transforms media at ingest on some paths (resizing, format_conversion, compression, metadata_stripping are all listed in the manifest). Verify that originals come back byte-identical.

evidence.proved: literal body: api_url https://nostrmedia.com/upload, download_url https://file.nostrmedia.com, supported_nips [94,96,98], plans.free.max_byte_size 26214400, file_expiration [0,0], media_transformations image [resizing, format_conversion, compression, metadata_stripping]
